market_view: After Monday's sharp fall (Nifty -1.75%, banks -3.2%, metals -3.7%, IT +2%) and weak Asian markets this morning, expect a soft or flat open. Large oversold names and the day's relative-strength leaders are the best odds for an open-to-close gain.

picks.reason: Fell 4% on Monday in a bank-led sell-off described as profit booking, with no company-specific bad news; still up 14% over 20 days and only 4% below its high. Heavily sold large banks often recover during the following session.
IT was the only sector to rise on Monday; Coforge closed at a 52-week high, up 2.7% on 1.6x normal volume and 6.6% over five days. Leaders at new highs on a down day tend to keep their strength.
Defensive pharma with strong momentum: up 3.3% on a falling day, 6.8% over five days and 15% over 20, 3% below its high. Defensive leaders tend to hold up if the market stays weak.

note: Made by the owner's main Claude session following daytrade/MORNING.md, because the scheduled morning session stopped without saving picks.
